description.value: Teppan Village has been a fixture of Whistler Village since 1989, serving authentic Japanese teppanyaki with steaks, seafood, and sushi prepared tableside by specialized chefs. Located upstairs in the Hilton Resort & Spa at Mountain Square, it seats up to 120 guests at communal teppanyaki tables in a lively, social atmosphere. Vegetarian and gluten-free options are available, and the restaurant is a popular choice for group dinners and celebrations.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 96m; rack at 98m.
